<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Spotty Rabbit 35</title>
<style>
/* Spotty Rabbit 35 by mrhyddenn — https://uiverse.io/mrhyddenn/spotty-rabbit-35 */
button {
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 15px 15px;
  border-radius: 10px;
}

button:hover {
  background: rgba(170, 170, 170, 0.062);
  transition: 0.5s;
}

button svg {
  color: #fff;
}
</style>
</head>

    </svg>
</button>

</body>
